---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or card type
labels: enhancement
---

## What you'd like

Clear, short description of the feature.

## Why

What problem does it solve? Who benefits?

## Possible shape

If you've thought about implementation, sketch it here. For card type
requests, show the manifest (`meta.view.display`, `writeable.inputs`)
you'd want to write. If it's a new renderer or server capability,
describe the contract.

## Alternatives

What could you already do with existing Klebb primitives? Why isn't
that good enough?

## Anything else

Links, screenshots from other apps, prior art.
